page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter · 2 marks

steps.label: The statement
lines: It is impossible to measure both the position
and the momentum of a particle at the same
time to any desired degree of accuracy.
steps.margin_note: First mark. Three parts: both quantities, at the same time, not to any desired accuracy.
steps.why: The principle is about the pair, not about one quantity. Either one alone can be measured as accurately as we like; measuring both together is what the principle limits.
common_mistakes: Saying position cannot be measured accurately. It can; the limit is on measuring position AND momentum together.
Blaming the instruments. The limit stays even with perfect instruments — it comes from the wave nature of matter.

recall.must_convey: That position and momentum of a particle cannot both be measured at the same time to any desired accuracy.
accept: cannot measure position and momentum together
reject: delta x delta p is about h bar

steps.memory_tip: The principle limits the PAIR: position and momentum, together, at one instant.

steps.label: The uncertainty relation
lines: If Δx is the uncertainty in the position of
the particle and Δp is the uncertainty in its

lines.text: Δx · Δp ≈ ℏ, where ℏ = h/2π

steps.margin_note: Second mark. Define Δx and Δp, then the relation. Making Δx smaller forces Δp larger.
steps.why: The book's marked form is the approximate relation Δx·Δp ≈ ℏ. The standard sharp statement is Δx·Δp ≥ ℏ/2 — both say the same thing: the two uncertainties cannot both be made small together.
common_mistakes: Writing plain h for ℏ. The relation uses ℏ = h/2π.
Leaving Δx and Δp undefined. The symbols must be named as the uncertainties in position and momentum.

recall.must_convey: That the product of the uncertainty in position and the uncertainty in momentum is of the order of h bar.
accept: delta x times delta p is about h bar
product of the uncertainties is h by two pi
delta x delta p greater than or equal to h bar by two
reject: cannot measure position and momentum together

steps.memory_tip: Two deltas multiply to ℏ — squeeze one down and the other must grow.

insider_note: The lecturer starred this one in the source book. Write the word statement first, then the relation with Δx and Δp defined — the relation alone is half the answer.
